---
title: "Government spending"
description: "What the State spends its money on."
---

The State spent €134 billion in 2025. A third of this went on social welfare and other benefits, such as pensions, jobseeker payments and child benefit. Just over a quarter went on the pay of public servants, such as nurses, teachers and Gardaí.

{{< chart public-finances-spending >}}

Interest on government debt cost €2.9 billion in 2025, about 2% of all spending.

For spending by purpose, such as health, education and social protection, and how it matches the money coming in, see [Where public money goes](where-money-goes.qmd).
